description: Dam levels, water flowing in and out, and canal release schedules
summary: This page shows dam storage levels and canal release schedules for this district, checked every 6 hours from India-WRIS (Water Resources Information System). Storage is shown as a percentage of each dam's total capacity. It also shows how much water is flowing into and out of the dams and reservoirs that serve this district.
emptyTitle: No dam or canal readings for {district} yet.
emptyBody: Dam levels, inflow, outflow and canal releases from {portal} and India-WRIS will show here once we start receiving them for this district.
tileFillingSub: More water flowing in than out
halfCount: {n} of {total} dams are more than half full.
halfAbout: About {n} of every 10 dams are more than half full.
explainerTogether: Together, the {n} dams hold about {pct} of the water they can store.
explainerRange: {fullest} is the fullest at {fullestPct} and {lowest} is the lowest at {lowestPct}.
explainerOne: {dam} is about {pct} full{flow, select, in {, and more water is flowing in than out.} out {, and more water is flowing out than in.} other {.}}
flowUnits: Cusecs (cubic feet per second) at each dam's latest reading
flowSimple: {n} of {total} dams have more water flowing in than going out.
pctHelp: Water stored now, as a share of the reservoir's total capacity
liveHelp: Usable water stored compared with total capacity, in million cubic metres (MCM)
levelHelp: Water level in the reservoir, in feet
inflowHelp: Water flowing into the reservoir, in cusecs
outflowHelp: Water let out of the reservoir for irrigation, drinking water or flood control, in cusecs
trendUnits: Per cent of the dam's full capacity, one point per reading
trendSame: From {from} to {to}, {dam} stayed at about {end} full.
trendChange: From {from} to {to}, {dam} went from {start} to {end} full.
